nodes.statement: The biogenic-amine cross-feeding ODE is bistable — a protective acidic Lactobacillus attractor and a Gardnerella-dominant BV attractor with a ~mM amine pool — reproducing the two-way loop Borgogna 2021 and Puebla-Barragan 2021 quantify.
